title: Verify: game vitest config phaser alias unit tests
summary: Add the phaser alias to the test config and assert it
description: This Verify unit owns the change to game/vitest.config.ts (a test configuration) and adds the test that asserts the alias, so Act is not rejected for touching test files.
acceptance_criteria: Given the config, when its alias is read, then phaser maps to game/frontend/node_modules/phaser
Given the config, when its alias is read, then @game still maps to game/src
technical_constraints: Only the config file read from disk and the imported config object; no vitest process is started inside the test
definition_of_done: Alias added and alias test green

steps.action: Add a 'phaser' entry to resolve.alias next to '@game', computed with fileURLToPath(new URL('./frontend/node_modules/phaser', import.meta.url))
steps.code: alias: { '@game': fileURLToPath(new URL('./src', import.meta.url)), phaser: fileURLToPath(new URL('./frontend/node_modules/phaser', import.meta.url)) }
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/vitestPhaserAlias.test.ts

steps.action: Create a test that imports the default export of '../vitest.config' and asserts config.resolve.alias.phaser ends with 'frontend/node_modules/phaser' and config.resolve.alias['@game'] ends with '/src'; also assert BootScene.ts source read from disk contains "import Phaser from 'phaser'"
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/vitestPhaserAlias.test.ts
